flora: Dense thicket of Giant Horsetails (varying heights, reaching 3 meters)
Floating aquatic ferns (in the water foreground)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; thick reed-like appearance; lush but organized into a clear 'hedge' or bank; no sharp/aggressive angles; emphasizing the proximity to water.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view showing a dense, vertical 'forest' of horsetails lining the edge of a slow-moving, muddy brown river channel. The water reflects the vibrant red soil of the banks.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated muddy brown soil transitioning into shallow water at the bottom of the frame.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, direct sunlight filtered through a slight riverside haze, creating soft dappled shadows on the segmented stalks.
